question: A 5% decrease in poverty by 2007 was one of main objectives of the _______ plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tenth Year Plan (2002-2007)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Tenth Five-Year Plan (2002-2007):**

 
 
• The Tenth Five-Year Plan had a primary objective of reducing poverty by 5% by the year 2007.
 
• It focused on achieving faster and more inclusive growth.
 
• It also aimed to improve the quality of life for all citizens.
